meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: Claude 会把 iMessage 适配器复制进 NanoClaw、注册到通道、装好固定版本依赖并构建验证；然后引导你选本地（本机 Mac）或远程（Photon）模式，写入对应配置并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词，或要求给 NanoClaw 加 iMessage 通道、走到 /setup 流程时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage，用本地模式
say.note: 走本机 chat.db，需给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问

say.text: 通过 Photon 远程接入 iMessage
say.note: 会要你填 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API 密钥

say.text: 我的 iMessage 联系方式是 +14155551234
say.note: 作为 owner handle，用于发欢迎消息

howto.what_en: Claude copies the iMessage adapter into NanoClaw, registers it as a channel, installs the pinned dependency and builds it. Then it walks you through local (Mac) or remote (Photon) mode, writes the env keys, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar phrases, or when you ask to add an iMessage channel to NanoClaw, including inside /setup.

say_en.text: Add iMessage to NanoClaw in local mode
say_en.note: Uses this Mac's chat.db; needs Full Disk Access for Node
Asks for your Photon server URL and API key
Used as the owner handle for the welcome message
